records.words: Test finished doors in quiet time? That is literally what I wanted last time. Resume.
Big screen this time, the hill is huge and readable. Same cellar, same one jar. The menu promised I can test doors in quiet time now, so: dig, door, test it. No false alarm.
Sideways out of the cellar to the right, a proper room this time.
One square is a cupboard. Another one.
Shaft door again, it worked last time.
Waiting for someone to carve it.
Meryem is carving my door already, faster than last time. Also the dig I marked to the right is not in her task. Fine, door first.

(late, 66s) I want to test the finished door without a false alarm, the start menu promised that. Chalk, door, look, bell, speeds, Journal all clearly clickable on this big screen; hill is big and readable. Door marked at 25s, carved and rolled by 66s, now it is night 20 Aug. The right-side dig has not started. No riders cue. Now: how do I ask to test it in quiet time?
Looking at my door. Is there a test button now?
Same bell sentence as last time. Where is the quiet-time test? Opening More.

Everyone is asleep at home. No test-in-quiet button anywhere. Hmm, those start-screen boxes said NEW hill, and I resumed an old one. So maybe I do not get the door test at all. That deflates me a bit. Maybe I can ask a person instead.
Meryem built my door. Can I talk to her?
She is 19 like me and maps land. Yes, invite her. She needs food though, oops.
Pending until she wakes. Letting it run.
Ugh, I waited 20 seconds with the panel open and time was paused. Closing it properly.
Room dug. Meryem still has not answered my invite though. Fine, store the jars.
Beds in the cellar part next to the store.
Three of the six people dots filled in! That little visual is satisfying. Need room for three more.
Oh I can SEE the round stone door in the shaft and people down there with the jars. Big screen is nice. Extending the dig right.
Riders search 9 steps, okay, a bit maths-y. Whatever, dig more.
I can see my door and people under ground now, that is nice, but Meryem never answered my invite and the door test I came for is not here.
Too dark to dig, and now water is dry too. Chores pile up. Lamp first.

She answered! She left marks off her clean map and wants to put them back. That is a little confession, honest about what she actually saw. I like her. But it was hidden inside her card; nothing told me on the main screen. Let me read her More.
She feels joy. Aww. Okay who else can I invite? Kian with the sister.
A road story, yes please.
Old map! Meryem said she left marks off the clean map. Maybe grandpa and granddaughter disagree. Asking.
Two invites out, waiting for answers.
Again! The x on a person drops me back to the village list, which pauses time, and I sat 30 seconds frozen. Same trap twice. Annoying.

OH. The Very Small King lets nobody in taller than the owner, Ada invented it. That is adorable, and it is a door joke! And Yusuf admits he kept people working past the agreed time and someone got hurt. Who is the injured worker?? Now I care. This is the stuff.
Requested layout check, not spontaneous play.
Layout check: tapping look at phone size.
Phone view: hill tiny, only one line of news. Back to desktop.

Layout check (requested, at 299-305s): at phone size the hill showed mostly blank dirt, my rooms were pushed off the right edge under the zoom buttons, and only one news line was visible. Glad I am on the big screen. Back at 1280. Now: who is the injured worker? Tariq was just sitting and resting...

Recognition guess at ~312s: Tariq’s father Yusuf and stepmother Zehra. In Valley there was a Zehra who pushed back and asked who feeds her family, and a Yusuf who said I won’t forget who sent this. Same pair?? Low-medium confidence, could just be common names. My reaction: wait, is this Zehra’s kid? That makes me grin. Not verifying. Giving Tariq the leftover material.
Closing twice this time, I learned.
Not dug yet. Fine. Back to waiting for Tariq.
Tiny boat with a failed sail! Each invite gives a small specific personality moment, and that is the game I actually want. The digging is the background now.
She already does this all day. Inviting her to do her own job feels a bit silly, but okay.
Her son Yusuf at the well settlement, so Tariq’s dad Yusuf. And it says Hajja feels joy, who is Hajja? Probably her nickname. Giving her the smooth piece.

Everyone keeps confessing a little mistake: Meryem’s map marks, Yusuf’s overtime, Tamar’s gesture, Maryam keeps her impossible knots. Cute, though I notice it is the same shape every time. And a whole new family of 3 just arrived with a donkey. Now 9 people and room for 3. Uh oh, I have to actually dig now.
Huh, the view jumped. My burrow is jammed at the right edge behind the zoom buttons, probably from the phone resize. Fit hill.
Ah, the tunnel is long now, they dug it. Beds on the far right end.
Six dots! Three more.
Space for everyone! All nine dots filled. That felt good and quick. Now, the new family, can I talk to them?
Kadir, Rabia, Yakup. Opening Rabia.
Rabia has no story and no invite button. She is just a name that ploughs. Disappointing after the others.

Yakup is ONE year old and says “It is what I do at this hour.” Haha, a baby quoting his routine. That is a bit broken-funny. The new family has no invites and no backstory, so the people-poking runs out.
Everyone has a bed. Letting it run to see what happens next, maybe riders.
SMOKE! Finally a real one. Ringing it, not a false alarm this time. Will someone shut my door?
Meryem: after I finish eating. Girl, there are RIDERS. I love and hate it. Watching.

WHAT. I built nine beds and six of them slept OUTSIDE while riders searched. Even baby Yakup. “If the riders had attacked, he would have been caught.” They all said after I eat, after I eat. And my door? Nobody mentioned shutting it. I feel kind of stupid and kind of betrayed. This is a scout visit and they will come back with more. Okay now I am invested, I want them to actually sleep below.

Okay most are below now, but ALL 9 beds are reachable by an open door. My door. Nobody has shut it, the bell is still ringing. I cannot shut it myself. I just get to watch and hope. That is the thing that bugged me last visit too.
If I cannot shut the door, I will dig past the 9 steps. Going down from the far end.
Still reachable. Counting passage steps on a hill drawing is homework-y. I will snake it back left underneath.
The scout scare got me more invested than anything, but now I am counting squares from the entrance and every new mark is still reachable, so it is turning into maths.

Three checkmarks at once! Sleeping space, stone door, survived first visit. Okay that is a little dopamine hit, even though half of them slept outside. Next time they may strike. Now is quiet time, the start menu said I can test doors in quiet time. Let me look at the door again.
Missed, tapped plain stone. Nobody has seen what is inside this stone, ha, poetic.
The view shifted on me again since my last screenshot, so my deep chalk landed in the middle, not where I aimed. Ugh. Door is here.

I would stop here. The start screen promised “test finished doors in quiet time” and it is quiet time and the door still only says ring the bell. I think those options were for a new hill, not this one, but nothing told me that once I clicked Resume. And during the real raid nobody shut it either. The one thing I came back for, I still cannot touch.
Nobody has a new invite line. Kian and Tamar are still sleeping-outside people. Closing and letting the days run.
It still says paused for reading with every panel shut. I am waiting, but for what?
A day jumped. Storage done, new goal: room for families who hear of the hill. More newcomers might bring new stories, that I want.
They dug my deeper bit after all, a little room under the hall. I will chalk sideways from it for new families.
A donkey family! Okay, room for three more, chalking beside the little lower room.
Who are the donkey people? Last newcomers had no stories at all.
The news line moved before I tapped it. Going to the people list instead.
Rıza? That name was in Halil's goals in Voice, his friend. Guess only, low confidence, it is a common name. My reaction: oh, a little ghost from another game, let me poke him.
Ha, this Rıza is five years old. Not Halil's friend then, guess dropped. "I want to do something easier" from a five-year-old is cute. Still no invite button for newcomers, same as the Şahins.
Letting them dig the room for the donkey family.
Repeated 19 times. The news is a loop of the same five sentences. Is my square dug?
Lower room is wider now. Beds for the Çeliks.
Beds for twelve, all filled dots. Satisfying for a second, but I am just answering the top line now: newcomers arrive, dig, beds, repeat. The donkey family has no words for me.
Switching to Fast myself: nothing for me to do, I want to see if the riders come back and strike like the news warned.
Fast still only did two days in thirty seconds? Feels the same as Steady. Checking Journal for anything not repeated 20 times.
Same four people doing the same four chores. The village is in a holding pattern until riders, I guess.
Everyone is sitting and resting, all twelve. Can I ask Meryem anything new?
Invite is grey now. There is End optional work, never pressed it. Does she get annoyed? Trying it.
I pressed End optional work and nothing changed on screen at all. Same text, button still there. Did it do anything? No reply from her.
Just waiting for riders now. Phone face-down energy.

Oh, End optional work did land, just late: she agrees to stop after her current activity. Very polite paperwork. I sort of fired her from mapping by accident and she did not mind at all. Wish she had grumbled.
Repeated 26 times. Still no riders. Giving it one more stretch.
Another donkey family, same sentence word for word, just a new surname. I can see the loop now: family arrives, chalk, beds.
Chalked the Yıldız room. It is the same three-step chore as the Çeliks, and nobody new talks. The people stories were the good part and they have dried up.
Fifteen minutes. I am done; the loop is clear and the people have gone quiet.
Wait, eight more empty dots just appeared, another family or two came. Still stopping.

Stopping at 21 September with the hill full of donkey families. The invites were the best thing: Kian's Very Small King, Tariq's boat, Maryam keeping her mistakes. Once everyone had answered, it became chalk, beds, wait, and the same five lines repeated thirty times. I still could not test the door myself. I would close it, not leave it running. I would not return voluntarily tonight. Maybe another evening if new people came with their own words to discover. Feedback: I'm stopping pressed locally, nothing typed, nothing submitted, consent unchanged.
